patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,79 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.frame_scores = []
+        self.current_frame = 0
+        self.frame_rolls = []
+        self.game_over = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.game_over:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        if pins < 0 or pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pins must be between 0 and 10")
+        
+        # Check if current frame is valid
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+            if self.current_frame < 9:  # Not the tenth frame
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Frame cannot have more than 10 pins")
+            else:  # Tenth frame
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10:  # First roll was a strike
+                    if len(self.frame_rolls) == 2 and self.frame_rolls[1] < 10 and self.frame_rolls[1] + pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Frame cannot have more than 10 pins")
+        
+        self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # Handle frame completion
+        if self.current_frame < 9:  # Frames 1-9
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 2 or self.frame_rolls[0] == 10:
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+        else:  # Tenth frame
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+                # Check if we need a third roll
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or sum(self.frame_rolls) == 10:
+                    # Need third roll
+                    pass
+                else:
+                    # Frame is complete
+                    self.game_over = True
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:
+                # Frame is complete
+                self.game_over = True
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.game_over and len(self.frame_rolls) > 0:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        if not self.game_over and self.current_frame < 10:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        for frame in range(10):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                break
+                
+            # Check for strike (first roll of frame is 10)
+            if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:
+                # Strike
+                frame_score = 10
+                if roll_index + 1 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                total_score += frame_score
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                # Check for spare or open frame
+                frame_score = self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                if frame_score == 10:
+                    # Spare
+                    if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                        frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                total_score += frame_score
+                roll_index += 2
+                
+        return total_score
